content.summary: The telecoms giant apologised for the outage, which it said was linked to a ‘non-malicious software issue’.

content.title: Vodafone reveals cause of massive internet blackout amid calls for compensation
content.summary: Vodafone has said a massive blackout in its internet coverage yesterday was not caused by a cyber attack.  "On Monday afternoon, for a short time, the Vodafone network had an issue affecting broadband, 4G and 5G services," said a Vodafone spokesperson.  As well as internet connections, Vodafone's app, website and customer services were also down.

content.title: Vodafone hit by massive blackout
content.summary: Vodafone has suffered a massive network blackout, leaving hundreds of thousands of mobile, broadband and landline customers across Britain without signal or internet for hours.

content.title: Vodafone internet services down for thousands of users
content.summary: Tens of thousands of Vodafone users were affected by an outage across its internet services.  The outages began on Monday afternoon, according to the monitoring website DownDetector, which reported more than 130,000 issues with Vodafone connections.  The company has more than 18 million UK customers, with nearly 700,000 of those using Vodafone's home broadband connection.

content.title: Thousands of Vodafone customers hit by internet outage
content.summary: The telecoms giant said on Monday afternoon that it is trying to fix a major issue which has impacted its broadband, 4G and 5G services.
